DoTrack — Deep QA Re-Test Report

Date: Aug 18-19, 2026 | Environment: production (Next.js app; assets from /_next/static, server responding with 200s)

SCOPE COVERED

  • Landing page: loaded correctly. Title "DoTrack — Automation Lifecycle Platform". Hero H1, eight tracked states, How-it-works, Built-for-regulated-orgs features, Pricing (Basic $1200, Standard $3600, Premium $8400 "most chosen", Enterprise $18000; add-ons table). Nav links Lifecycle/How it works/Pricing/#anchor work (verified Pricing -> /#pricing); Sign in (/login), Register (/register) valid.
  • Logins (all Password123!):
  • Company Admin admin@firstvalley.com (Diana Reynolds) -> /dashboard. PASS.
  • Business Supervisor s.inman@firstvalley.com (Swapna Patil) -> supervisor portal with role-switcher. PASS.
  • Technical User k.okonkwo@firstvalley.com (Kwame Okonkwo) -> technical portal. PASS.
  • Wrong password -> "Invalid email or password" (graceful, no crash). XSS in email field -> treated as text, no execution. PASS.
  • Register/create-company wizard: 3-step (Org -> Administrator -> Plan). Continue disabled until fields filled; full flow with Standard plan submitted; POST /api/tenants returned 200 and redirected to /login (submitted for review). PASS. (Created a persistent pending tenant "QA Test Org".)
  • Company Admin modules: Company Profile, Settings & Branding, Departments (Add/Edit/Remove w/ DELETE-confirm), Users & Invitations (tabs, Add User, deactivate), All Workflows + workflow detail + team assignment, MSD Viewer (read-only), PDD Pipeline (kanban, 8 lanes), Capacity Requests (Approve/Decline), Activity Log (full audit trail), Billing (plan change request, invoices), My Account. All load and function.
  • Business Supervisor portal: MSD Editor (add/delete step authoring), MSD Approvals (pending 0), UAT Sign-off (no workflows in UAT). PASS.
  • Technical User portal: PDD Editor (inherited business steps read-only + editable Technical tab; add/delete technical step), My PDDs / PDD Delivery (assigned PDDs + delivery swim lane). PASS.

KEY FINDINGS / BREAKAGE

  • [ACCESS-CONTROL GAP, APP_CODE] Technical User (and by extension other non-admin roles) can navigate directly to /dashboard/users and see the FULL admin Users & Invitations management UI (all 7 users across all departments, Add User button, Deactivate/Edit) even though that route is hidden from their navigation. This conflicts with the platform's stated "role-separated portals" and "segregation of duties" design. Front-end renders the admin UI to a non-admin role on direct-URL access. Flagged FAIL (severity to confirm server-side). NOTE: Not attempted to Add/Edit as the technical user to avoid further data mutation.
  • [MINOR UX, APP_CODE] Empty submit on the Add Department form and the MSD Editor "Add Step" form silently does nothing (form stays open) with NO validation error message, unlike the Add User form which correctly shows "Name is required"/"Email is required".
  • [MINOR, APP_CODE] Support Contact field in Settings & Branding accepts non-email strings with no validation error.
  • [OBSERVATION, UNKNOWN_LAYER] A single console error appears on most pages; it correlates with the external chat widget loaded from apps.abacus.ai/chatllm/appllm-lib.js (all same-host assets return 200). Not caused by the app.
  • Route attacks: /this-page-does-not-exist, /%24%23%40, and nonexistent workflow UUID all return a friendly HTTP 404 page ("This page could not be found.") with no crash. PASS.
  • Network: all API calls return 200; failed logins return a proper 401. No 4xx/5xx from app endpoints during normal use.

DATA CHANGES MADE DURING TESTING

(documented for awareness; most were restored)

  • Capacity Request REQ-1519 APPROVED (no UI revert).
  • Capacity Request CR-0001 DECLINED (no UI revert).
  • Created then DEACTIVATED QA Test User (qa.testuser@firstvalley.com) - remains in list as DEACTIVATED (no delete option).
  • Created plan-change request SUB-3472 (Enterprise, reason "QA test - requesting upgrade").
  • Registered new tenant "QA Test Org" for review.
  • Fully restored: test department (created+deleted), step in MSD-4503 (added+deleted), technical step in PDD-6723 (added+deleted), phone in My Account, org name and support contact values after XSS checks.
  • XSS payloads in Company Profile (org name) and Settings (support contact) were stored as literal escaped text and NOT executed (no XSS). Values restored to originals.

WHAT WORKS WELL

All three roles authenticate; the role-switched portals render correctly; MSD Editor/PDD Editor authoring (add/delete steps with confirm dialogs); workflow assignment/unassignment; capacity request approve/decline; billing plan-change request; register wizard E2E; 404 handling; XSS input sanitization; audit trail recording; delete confirmations (type DELETE; confirm dialogs).

SUMMARY:

Site is largely functional and robust. Primary action item is the role-based access-control gap on /dashboard/users (and possibly other admin routes) for non-admin roles, plus minor UX validation gaps on two empty-submit forms.

explore_role_access_control FAIL
While logged in as the Technical User (Kwame Okonkwo), navigated directly to /dashboard/users (an admin/team-management route NOT present in the Technical User's navigation). The page rendered the full 'Users & Invitations' management UI showing all 7 users across all departments (including Company Admin Diana Reynolds, supervisors Swapna Patil/Rajesh Patil, etc.) plus an 'Add User' button and Deactivate/Edit actions. This is a potential authorization/access-control gap given the platform's 'segregation of duties' and 'role-separated portals' claims.
